SAJIT JAYARAM

TECHNOLOGY RISK | GOVERNANCE & COMPLIANCE

Mail: rnair2024@gmail.com Ph: +91 7760969200. In: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sajit-

jayaram-47687060/

SUMMARY

Technology Risk and GRC professional with 16+ years of experience delivering technology initiatives

within regulated investment banking environments. Strong background in risk assessment, control

governance, audit readiness, stakeholder management, and compliance coordination in alignment to

frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM). Also

conceptualised a SaaS-based platform, providing exposure to product lifecycle, data handling, and

access governance considerations. Seeking Technology Risk / GRC or Product Manager roles to

contribute to cybersecurity risk management.

SKILLS

Tech Risk & GRC

Technology Risk Management

IT Risk Assessment

Risk Register & Risk Treatment

Control Design & Eﬀectiveness Testing

NIST CSF, ISO 27001

SOC2 Audit Readiness

Audit & Compliance Support

Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)

Project / Change

Stakeholder Management

Management

Governance & Reporting

Requirements Documentation

RAID / RACI

Change Management

Tools

Basic Python, SQL, Jira, SharePoint, Confluence, Visio, Signavio

Operating Systems

Linux, Windows

EXPERIENCE

Senior Consultant - Project Manager / GRC Consultant

Capco Technologies Pvt Ltd

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

August 2016 - January 2025

GRC Consultant

TPRM - Executed Third-Party Risk Assessment (TPRM) for on-prem to cloud migration, including

vendor classification, inherent and residual risk evaluation, control & due diligence.

SOC2 Audit Readiness - Supported SOC 2 Type II audit readiness for CC6.1 and CC8.1 TSC controls

by coordinating logical access reviews, change management governance, audit evidence tracking,

and remediation activities across technology teams.

ISO 27001 Audit Readiness - Supported ISO 27001 audit readiness for a cloud-native SaaS

organisation by coordinating ISMS scoping, risk assessments, control remediation, audit evidence

tracking, and governance activities across security, infrastructure, and engineering teams.

Risk Assessment & Treatment - Identified and translated technical vulnerabilities into risk registers

and remediation plans aligned to NIST CSF and ISO 27001 control requirements.

Project Manager

Delivered technology initiatives within regulated investment banking environments, ensuring

adherence to governance and risk management practices.

Identified and tracked technology risks and issues through structured RAID logs; facilitated

mitigation planning and escalation where required.

Collaborated with Information Security and Compliance stakeholders to incorporate security and

control considerations into project planning and execution.

Supported internal and external audit engagements by coordinating documentation, facilitating

stakeholder walkthroughs, and tracking remediation items to closure.

Prepared governance and risk reports for senior stakeholders, highlighting risk posture, control gaps,

and mitigation progress.

Gathered and documented business and security-related requirements, including access controls

and compliance considerations.

Coordinated UAT activities to validate system functionality and ensure appropriate access

provisioning before production deployment.

Technical Coordinator - Business Analyst

Northern Trust (Northern Trust Operating Services Pvt Ltd)

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

February 2009 - August 2016

Requirements Gathering & User Stories for Global Reconciliations.

UAT Management

Project Documentation - BRD, Defects Log, Test Cases, UAT Strategy and Coordination.

Stakeholder Management

Design Dashboards, Application pages with UI/UX team

Process Workflows - Current & Future State

Project Governance & Reporting

ENTREPRENEURIAL EXPERIENCE

Founder / Product Manager – CSR SaaS Platform (2019 - 2022)

Conceptualised and developed a proof-of-concept SaaS platform enabling corporate CSR and

individual donors to contribute products and services to NGOs.

Conducted market research and competitive analysis to evaluate existing solutions, identify gaps,

and inform product design and platform considerations.

Wire-framed the UI (pages for all user types) for PoC.

Structured a phased product roadmap starting with core marketplace functionality, followed by

access control, governance features like audit logging.

Defined product workflows, features and user journeys across B2B and B2C use cases.

Evaluated cloud deployment and third-party integration considerations.

Identified data handling and access considerations during platform design.

Engaged stakeholders to validate concept and refine platform requirements & features.
